Done! The retry count is now configurable through the `RETRY_COUNT` environment variable, defaulting to 3 when not set. The `retries()` function remains unchanged, so all existing code continues to work the same way.

To use it:
- Default behavior: `node app.js` (uses 3 retries)
- Custom retry count: `RETRY_COUNT=5 node app.js` (uses 5 retries)
